import { Skeleton } from '@app/design-system'
import type { ReactNode } from 'react'
import { t } from '../../../lib/i18n'
import { meta } from './page.meta'

// The workspaces page's loading UI: the heading and the two rows the list is about to paint,
// so the content lands without a layout shift.
// SOURCE: https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/loading
export default function WorkspacesLoading(): ReactNode {
  return (
    <output
      aria-busy="true"
      aria-label={t('workspaces.loading')}
      data-testid={meta.states.loading}
      className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-3xl flex-col gap-6 px-6 py-10"
    >
      <Skeleton width={220} height={32} rounded="md" />
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <Skeleton fullWidth height={54} rounded="lg" />
        <Skeleton fullWidth height={54} rounded="lg" />
      </div>
    </output>
  )
}
